questions.answer: Enjoy the food.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Go on a hiking trip to the mountains.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Many Japanese are shy of speaking English and many can´t speak anything at all. That makes it hard. But people are very helpful. You need an open mind.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Join a circle or some of the university events.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
It takes a lot of effort with procedures getting into the university.
It is worth it all. 
Japan is cracking.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: You need to be ready for the bureaucracy and loads of paperwork.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Enjoying a completely different way of living.
